text: 1. Excellent Non-Chinese graduates with good academic performance, good health, and no criminal record.2. Less than 35 years old for Master's degree study; Less than 40 years old for Doctoral degree study.3. Not have been funded by any organizations or institutions (must have a statement).4. Language Eligibility:Chinese-taught program applicants should provide an HSK level 4 test score of 260 or above. Applicants with an HSK Level 4 score of 180 or above but below 260 will be eligible for one year Chinese language preparation.English-taught program applicants should obtain a minimum score of 6 in IELTS or 85 in TOEFL.Those who meet one of the following conditions are exempt from proving their linguistic competence:a. Applicants whose first language or the official language of the country is Chinese or English.b. Applicants who have taken a degree program taught in Chinese or English.5. Applicants must have a strong academic background, scientific and innovative ability.
